description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users, including dispatcher CAD sign-in
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Dispatchers, ePCR users, clinic staff, and billing staff all sign in through SYS-G1; a long outage stops every division at once
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; cached CAD sessions and local break-glass console accounts at each communications center
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by every process below; the CAD fallback depends on break-glass accounts being current

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Network hub, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B; hosts the CAD, integration engine, and revenue cycle platform
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The CAD, CAD-to-CAD interfaces, and the integration engine run in provider A; a landing-zone outage is a dispatch outage
manual_workaround: None for the CAD until the provider B CAD standby exists (gap 1); manual dispatch mode
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: BDS CAD and revenue cycle; Ambulance integration engine; Urgent Care online check-in

description: Links to the 4 communications centers, 520 clinics, ambulance stations, and offices (about 1,100 sites)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Communications centers reach the CAD in provider A over the WAN; clinics reach the vendor-hosted EHR
manual_workaround: Dual carriers and cellular failover at each communications center; cellular failover at clinics; ambulances use cellular directly
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All communications centers and clinics

business_process: Emergency medical dispatch (CAD and call handling)
description: Call intake, emergency medical dispatch protocol, unit recommendation, and unit status for the Ambulance division and 14 external EMS agencies at 4 communications centers
process_owner: BDS vice president of communications operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety: delayed dispatch can cost lives; county agreements and client contracts set response-time standards and require notice of outages within minutes
manual_workaround: Manual dispatch: paper incident cards, status boards, and radio from each center binder; another center takes calls if only one center is down
dependent_third_parties: CAD vendor; county P25 radio systems; carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Dispatches the Ambulance division (BP-AM01, BP-AM02) and 14 external agencies; depends on SYS-G1, SYS-G3, BP-G04

description: Field response under 38 county and municipal agreements: unit assignment, unit status, vehicle location, and response-time tracking
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Life safety; county response-time standards with penalties; county notice duties under each agreement
manual_workaround: Radio status reports; paper run tickets; supervisors post units by map
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 fleet mobile systems; SYS-D4 CAD
dependent_third_parties: County P25 radio systems; cellular carriers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BDS dispatch (BP-BD01) and CAD-to-CAD (BP-BD02)

description: Incident hand-off from 21 county PSAPs to the BDS CAD (incident type, address, callback number, notes)
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without the interface each PSAP must voice-transfer every EMS call, which adds about a minute per call
manual_workaround: PSAP voice transfer and radio announcements
dependent_systems: SYS-D4 CAD; integration engine on SYS-G3
dependent_third_parties: County PSAPs and their CAD vendors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Ambulance 911 response depends on it; one feed is under CJIS review (gap 5)

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks (164.404, 164.410, Form 8-K Item 1.05, county and client contracts) keep running during an outage; blind spots let attackers spread
manual_workaround: Retainer firm tooling; EDR console reachable from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Every division depends on the SOC for detection and for the facts behind notices

description: Cardiac monitors send 12-lead ECGs to receiving hospitals through the monitor vendor relay for heart attack and stroke alerts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety: hospitals activate cardiac teams before arrival
manual_workaround: Radio or phone report to the hospital; crew reads the ECG and calls the alert
dependent_third_parties: Monitor vendor cloud relay (business associate); hospitals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Independent of the CAD; depends on vehicle routers (BP-AM05)

description: Vehicle routers, mobile data computers, and automatic vehicle location for about 2,400 ambulances
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Without vehicle location the CAD cannot recommend the closest unit; crews lose MDC incident details
manual_workaround: Radio position reports; dispatchers recommend units by map
dependent_systems: SYS-D1 routers and MDCs; SYS-D4 CAD
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds BP-BD01 unit recommendation

business_process: Urgent care visits and clinical documentation
description: Visits, orders, documentation, and discharge in the EHR at 520 clinics
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient safety (allergies, medications, prior visits); about $18.4 million revenue a day
manual_workaround: Read-only downtime workstations; paper downtime forms; divert walk-ins with serious symptoms to emergency departments
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in; WAN; 46 acquired clinics run a legacy system (gap 8)

description: New prescriptions including controlled substances from urgent care and telehealth visits
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients leave without medications
manual_workaround: Phone or paper prescriptions where state law allows
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1

description: Scheduled and unscheduled transports for about 260 hospitals and facilities, including critical care transfers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Hospital discharges and transfers back up; critical care transfers are time-sensitive; facility contracts
manual_workaround: Phone intake with paper trip sheets; dispatch by radio
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on BP-BD01; claims follow in BP-BD03

description: Point-of-care tests, x-ray, and reference lab results returned to providers and patients
process_owner: Urgent Care director of clinical operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Critical results must reach providers and patients; x-ray reads by contracted radiologists
manual_workaround: Labs and radiology groups phone critical results; paper requisitions
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Interface engine on SYS-G3; WAN

business_process: Patient care documentation and hospital record delivery
description: ePCR completion, delivery to receiving hospitals, and state EMS data submission
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: State EMS records rules (Florida worked example: the receiving hospital can request the record within 48 hours of dispatch, Rule 64J-1.014, F.A.C.); claims need the ePCR
manual_workaround: Tablets work offline and sync later; paper patient care records in every vehicle
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Feeds BDS claims (BP-BD03) and the coding assistant

description: Online check-in, wait-time display, and scheduling for clinics and telehealth
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Walk-in volume shifts to front desks; reputation
manual_workaround: Front-desk walk-in queue
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G3 hosting

description: Video visits with urgent care providers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patients redirected to clinics; telehealth notes must reach the EHR
manual_workaround: Phone visits where state law allows; redirect to clinics
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1

description: Notices to external dispatch and billing clients and to counties under BAAs and contracts
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client contracts require a call within 15 minutes of a CAD outage; BAA breach clocks of 72 hours for 31 billing clients and 10 calendar days for the rest
manual_workaround: Out-of-band contact list printed in each center binder; phone and email from managed mobile devices
dependent_people_or_facilities: BDS client services; communications center supervisors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on SOC facts (BP-G02)

description: Email, chat, and file sharing for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Internal coordination and some notices; out-of-band channels exist for incidents
manual_workaround: Out-of-band crisis line and managed mobile devices
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions

description: Shift scheduling, overtime, and certification tracking for field staff
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Unstaffed ambulances lower coverage; uncertified staff must not be scheduled
manual_workaround: Printed 2-week schedules; supervisors call staff
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: HR events from SYS-G4 drive credentials and access

description: Coding, claim submission, payment posting, and denials for both internal divisions and about 170 external clients
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow for the group and for clients; payers accept late claims within filing limits; client contracts set turnaround standards
manual_workaround: Queue claims; prioritize clients with short cash reserves
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 revenue cycle platform; file transfer servers
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Receives ePCR and EHR data from both covered-entity divisions

business_process: Patient billing contact center and card payments
description: Patient billing questions and about 40,000 card payments a month by phone
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Patient complaints; payment delays
manual_workaround: Callback queue; direct patients to the hosted payment page
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None beyond SYS-G1

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation; outside filing agent
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Needs incident facts from the SOC and every division

description: Demand model recommends where to post available ambulances each hour
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Posting plans can be run from static plans for a day without measurable delay
manual_workaround: Static posting plans by hour and day
dependent_systems: Posting model on SYS-G3; SYS-D4 CAD
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Reads CAD history

description: CAD vendor AI module transcribes calls and prompts upgrades at the Florida center
process_owner: BDS vice president of communications operations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Optional aid; telecommunicators use the dispatch protocol as the decision of record
manual_workaround: Turn the module off; protocol continues unchanged
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: None

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; termination events drive access removal
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Termination events feed SYS-G1

description: Monthly response-time and performance reports to 38 counties and municipalities
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Monthly reporting cycle; penalties depend on accurate response times
manual_workaround: Rebuild reports from CAD exports once restored
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Depends on CAD data integrity after an outage
